discription: A bright, detuned lead sound using two slightly detuned sawtooth oscillators for a thicker texture.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=0.5, pan=0; var sig1, sig2, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig1 = Saw.ar(freq); sig2 = Saw.ar(freq * (1 + (detune / 1000))); sig = (sig1 + sig2) * 0.5 * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan)); }
